criteria.title: Agreed pilot and account scope
criteria.action: Confirm selected company, accountable owner, timezone, actual plan and selected capabilities.
criteria.outcome: Named scope revision and original system responsibilities.

criteria.title: Original exports and row disposition
criteria.action: Retain every original file, record its mapping, and account for accepted, excluded and unresolved rows.
criteria.outcome: Complete source identities, field interpretations and reconciled row counts.

criteria.title: Property, visit and crew identity
criteria.action: Resolve actual ambiguous keys without merging by name alone.
criteria.outcome: Original keys and reasoned matching decisions.

criteria.title: Crew and property handoff
criteria.action: Observe the intended recipient's access and current secure-instruction handoff.
criteria.outcome: Actual role observation, recipient and discrepancies.

criteria.title: Single dated-visit change
criteria.action: Perform the intended live visit change and inspect adjacent original occurrences.
criteria.outcome: Requested scope, before and after source, observed surrounding dates.

criteria.title: Selected recurring-series operation
criteria.action: Perform the selected pause, resume, end or frequency action in the original system.
criteria.outcome: Observed future list and preserved historical records.

criteria.title: Dispatch exceptions
criteria.action: Review overlaps, entered capacity, travel or time-off conflicts.
criteria.outcome: Named owner resolution and explicit override reasons.

criteria.title: Actual visit and time review
criteria.action: Retain complete or unresolved original clock observations and completion sources.

criteria.title: Payroll period review
criteria.action: Select the original earnings/export edition and reconcile its time rows and adjustments.
criteria.outcome: Current reviewer decision against the exact received edition.

criteria.title: Payroll and export receiving
criteria.action: Have the intended recipient open the original chosen export.
criteria.outcome: Actual recipient/result and original file identity.

criteria.title: Selected commercial contract branch
criteria.action: If selected, reconcile actual contract, invoice and inspection under an observed supported account.
criteria.outcome: Original commercial sources or explicit out-of-scope reason.

criteria.title: Customer operating decision
criteria.action: Name the owner decision, remaining conditions and next responsible person.
criteria.outcome: Reasoned disposition from the actual observations.

criteria.title: Complete working-file receiving
criteria.action: Open a complete exported working file and its original attachments in a fresh copy.
criteria.outcome: Unchanged records, attachment identities and original decision.

criteria.title: Exit and custody
criteria.action: Account for every requested export category and keep cancellation/deletion separate.
criteria.outcome: Obtained files, outstanding owners and actual account dates.
